title: Joomla 4 500 after Akeeba restore: the missing action_logs fix
lede: A routine Akeeba restore. A blank white 500. Forty minutes of grep, schema reconstruction and one quiet INSERT later, the Joomla 4 site was back.
hero_alt: Paper schema sheet with CREATE TABLE action_logs, brass plate, wax-sealed RESTORE envelope, manila Akeeba tag on bone linen.
